title: Root-Level Sanity CMS Studio — Shared Smart CMS
description: Extract Sanity Studio from portfolio-v1/studio/ to a root-level studio/ directory. Make it a shared CMS serving both portfolio-v1 and portfolio-v2. Add Sanity Assist (AI-powered) as the primary smart feature. Use pnpm. Create a content lifecycle workflow for ongoing maintenance.

context.goal: A standalone, AI-powered Sanity CMS studio at the repo root that serves both portfolios with live editing, smart content assistance, and automated workflows

architecture.layout: Root-level studio/ with its own package.json, tsconfig, sanity.config.ts
architecture.sharedDataset: Both v1 and v2 read from the same Sanity project/dataset
architecture.deployment: Sanity Hosting via `sanity deploy` from studio/
architecture.aiAssist: Sanity Assist plugin for auto-suggestions, SEO optimization, content generation

consumers.v1: portfolio-v1/ reads via @sanity/client, fetches from Sanity API
consumers.v2: portfolio-v2/ reads via @sanity/client, fetches from Sanity API

epics.title: Studio Migration — Move to Root
epics.description: Extract studio from portfolio-v1/studio/ to root studio/, ensuring it works standalone.

acceptance: studio/ exists at root with all files intact

milestones.name: Shared CMS Configured
criteria: Both v1 and v2 connect to shared studio

risks.name: Data loss during migration
risks.mitigation: Export all data before migration, verify backup, test restore

risks.name: v1 breaks after studio moves
risks.mitigation: Update v1 imports to use shared studio, test thoroughly before removing v1/studio/

risks.name: Sanity Assist API costs
risks.mitigation: Monitor usage, set usage limits, optimize AI instructions

risks.name: Studio build fails after changes
risks.mitigation: Run type checks after each change, fix errors immediately

risks.name: Environment variable conflicts
risks.mitigation: Use distinct env var names, document clearly, test each consumer

successCriteria: Studio exists at root studio/ with all features working
Both portfolio-v1 and portfolio-v2 consume from shared Sanity dataset
Sanity Assist provides AI-powered suggestions for all schemas
Content health dashboard shows completeness scores
SEO preview shows Google and social media previews
Content lifecycle workflow documented and tested

commitPlan.strategy: One commit per story slice, grouped by epic
examples: chore(studio): move studio from portfolio-v1 to root
feat(studio): configure AI instructions for profile schema
docs(studio): add content lifecycle workflow guide

verification.typescript: cd studio && npx tsc --noEmit must pass
verification.eslint: cd studio && pnpm lint must pass
verification.build: cd studio && pnpm build must succeed
verification.v1integration: cd portfolio-v1 && pnpm dev — fetches from Sanity
verification.v2integration: cd portfolio-v2 && pnpm dev — fetches from Sanity
verification.assist: All schemas have working AI suggestions
